args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW KFB claymation INK BLOB MONSTER six-character sheet, Bronze Age Crete-inspired palace crafts and provisioning. Actual input images are bounded STYLE references for organic goo anatomy, rounded plasticine volume and handcrafted props. New cast and outfit designs. Exactly SIX unique complete upright figures, 3 columns x 2 rows, TRUE transparent PNG, landscape 1536x1024. All six at comparable substantial scale, each entire silhouette including prop and droplets inside its own cell with 32px outer and cell gutters. No scenelet, scenery, floor, shadow discs, lettering, logo, panel border or connecting effects.
Historical material inspiration: cream and rust-red short woven wraps, turquoise bead bands, spiral clay details, marine-blue pottery; face and blob anatomy dominant. Whimsical absurd-surreal everyday roles and satirical personalities across time. Museum-evoking craft cues interpreted as fictional multiverse game characters, not literal reconstructions. Each whole figure is a continuous short round DARK CHARCOAL ink splat with subtle plum shading, thick asymmetrical soft goo lobes and tiny ink hands; face directly sculpted into ink, bare rounded goo base, no humanoid legs or long torso. Clothing is a small accessory wrapping the blob; keep dominant organic ink mass. All eyes WHITE/IVORY sclera, RED iris, BLACK pupil, fully filled DARK sculpted lids. Soft tactile fingerprints, rich softly modeled clay, restrained satin light from upper left; no luminous lavender/white outline, fabric fibers on goo or liquid chrome. Rounded chunky tools, very few clear bold props. Teeth sit INSIDE mouth behind lips, never attached below/outside lip. Wide range of face shapes, gaze, posture and emotions; independent acting, no six identical grins. Two female-read characters as specified below. Original references must not cause copied military hats, wings, eyepatches or veteran insignia. Top row Palace Workshop, bottom row Harbour Circle, but every actor individually usable with independent props. Row-major:
1. Female-read overwhelmed storage keeper: low broad splat, one eyelid twitching, tight closed grimace. Simple prop: small clay storage jar with absurdly many chunky handles. Personality: Has a handle on everything except the inventory.
2. Male-read nervous festival athlete: tall thin curving blob, enormous wary eyes, a tiny round toothless gasp. Simple prop: small padded bull-horn-shaped practice grip held at belly. Personality: Performs confidence several seconds before acquiring it.
3. Male-read self-satisfied pottery painter: round heavy bean, one sleepy eye and one checking eye, closed wry smirk. Simple prop: round marine-style flask with a simple curled octopus motif and short brush. Personality: Signs every commission with an extra tentacle.
4. Male-read offended palace guard: wide soft hourglass splat, elevated outraged brows, a tight lower-lip pout. Simple prop: tiny figure-eight shield and very short blunt bronze spear. Personality: Regrets being assigned the ceremonial entrance.
5. Female-read rapturous wall painter: asymmetric droplet with a wide flat base, dreamy cross-directed eyes, crooked open two-tooth laugh. Simple prop: shallow blue pigment dish and broad stubby brush. Personality: Would happily repaint the end of the world.
6. Male-read miserable harbour porter: slumped chunky oval, low lids, thin deeply downturned closed mouth. Simple prop: small rope-bound amphora-shaped jar with a short folded sailcloth. Personality: Has carried the same urgent delivery since the last era.
Use new silhouettes and expressive peak acting, with charm, wear and offbeat cartoon character. Keep clearly separate generous transparent gutters and complete large figures. No extra actors or decorative loose props.
